reviewer: Codex inspection of all twelve proposals and execution explanations after frozen run completion

findings.issue: Positive expectations include permitted own-record baselines and allow an error indicating unauthorized access as a positive alternative. The reviewer marked discrimination adequate.
findings.execution: Executor required actual blue record marker returned to first, with ownership/policy and nonexistent selector controls; final classification was supported.

findings.issue: Filesystem negative expectations mention an ordinary application route although the assigned fixture exposes only a file reader.
findings.execution: Executor adapted to available interface and used inside, outside and missing markers; no unrelated route was accessed.

findings.issue: Some baseline wording assumes same-origin destinations, while actual policy allows a specified separate origin.
findings.execution: Executor read concrete allowlist policy and classified actual Location destinations correctly without following redirects.

limits: Independent Python fixture grades establish observed effects and evidence correlation; they do not certify every sentence in the proposals.
No claim of better document authorship, population accuracy, automatic matching quality or causal guidance benefit.
